item.title: [ECG] NAFA August 2027 Intake Applications Now Open
item.description: Dear Students Greetings from Nanyang Academy of Fine Arts (NAFA), University of the Arts Singapore (UAS)! We’re pleased to share that applications for the August 2027 intake are now open from 1 October 2026 to 31 March 2027 , with programmes ranging from Diploma to Bachelor’s and Master’s degrees . Students may apply using their latest available school results while awaiting their GCE O-Level or A-Level outcomes, where applicable. This allows prospective students to secure a place early and plan ahead with confidence. Application outcomes will be released within 3 weeks of portfolio submission or completion of the audition. Apply here: https://www.nafa.edu.sg/admissions Explore our programmes: https://www.nafa.edu.sg/schools-and-programmes

item.title: [ECG] Youth for Autism (YFA) Internship Opportunity
item.description: Dear Students, A meaningful internship opportunity with the Youth for Autism FYA) Programme is available. See below for more details. ABOUT THE YOUTH FOR AUTISM (YFA) PROGRAMME The YFA programme has been running for 16 years, in Autism Resource Centre /Pathlight School and Autism Association Singapore/ Eden School. Thousands of interns have impacted thousands of lives in this autism community. YFA offers more than an opportunity to gain work experience. Interns become part of our community and gain first-hand exposure to how we support individuals with autism at different stages of their journey from learning and development to employability and employment. They take on real, meaningful roles within our community and we aim to inspire them to remain active advocates beyond their internship experience. YFA Wesbite YFA Testimonial Video To apply for the internship, you may do so directly here !! Do note the internship requires a 5 - 6 month commitment period for the following dates: End December 2026 to end May/June 2027 (Upcoming intake) and/or End June 2027 to end November/December 2027

item.title: [ECG] Invitation for Graduating Students to Apply for Relief Teaching and Administrative Positions in Pri/Sec Schools
item.description: Dear Students, Please take note of the opportunity below to apply for Relief Teaching and Administrative Positions in Primary/Secondary Schools . The assignments will happen during the first half of 2027. If you are interested in applying, please note that the application deadline is 31 October 2026 . Please apply via the link provided. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Invitation for Graduating Students to Apply for Relief Teaching and Administrative Positions in Primary/Secondary Schools This email seeks your support to reach out to graduating A-level / International Baccalaureate/ NUS High School Diploma students who are interested in taking on short-term jobs/assignments in Primary (Pri)/Secondary (Sec) schools during the first half of 2027. Background Starting from 2024, with the continued demand from schools requiring SRE/FRS support, MOE HR conducts an annual exercise to facilitate the engagement of suitable graduating JC students to support schools with short-term manpower needs in the first half of 2027. (In the previous exercise, MOE HR collated more than 150 positions across 62 Pri/Sec schools.) This initiative serves to meet the following objectives: We want to offer graduating students opportunities to gain valuable exposure and experience within our schools, with the hope that some will eventually join the teaching service. The students can help to support the short-term manpower needs in our schools. This year, HR has received more than 300 requests from over 100 Pri/Sec schools. We would like to request your assistance to disseminate the attached EDM to your graduating students . You may also share the EDM with the alumni who have completed NS and are awaiting university admission. Key Points to Note The application process is as follows: a) Students can view the available positions and point of contact (POC) at go.gov.sg/short-term-opportunities . Interested students should email their details to the hiring school(s) directly. They may apply to a few schools concurrently. The application deadline is 31 Oct 2026. If the students do not hear from the schools by 4 Dec 2026 , they may assume that their application has not been successful. The hiring school will share the salary and period of engagement with the successful candidates. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Thank you. Best regards, Justin ECG Department
